bug: Answers a retried create with 201 instead of 200
Idempotency check compares only the title, so a re-POST with a different assignee is a 200 instead of 409
A retry echoes the request (status reset to open) instead of returning the stored task as it is now
PUT re-inserts the task at the end, so updating a task moves it in the list order
PUT merges instead of replacing: a missing assignee keeps the old value instead of becoming null
Does not persist updates: PUT changes memory only, so a restart loses them
Non-atomic save: copies the temp file over the store instead of renaming it, leaving .tmp files behind
